1: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: Will not one be cast down even at the sight of him?
2: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up; Who then is he that can stand before me?
3: Who hath first given unto me, that I should repay him? Whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.
4: I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, Nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.
5: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who shall come within his jaws?
6: Who can open the doors of his face? Round about his teeth is terror.
7: His strong scales are his pride, Shut up together as with a close seal.
8: One is so near to another, That no air can come between them.
9: They are joined one to another; They stick together, so that they cannot be sundered.
10: His sneezings flash forth light, And his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
11: Out of his mouth go burning torches, And sparks of fire leap forth.
12: Out of his nostrils a smoke goeth, As of a boiling pot and burning rushes.
13: His breath kindleth coals, And a flame goeth forth from his mouth.
14: In his neck abideth strength, And terror danceth before him.
15: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: They are firm upon him; they cannot be moved.
16: His heart is as firm as a stone; Yea, firm as the nether millstone.
17: When he raiseth himself up, the mighty are afraid: By reason of consternation they are beside themselves.
18: If one lay at him with the sword, it cannot avail; Nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.
19: He counteth iron as straw, And brass as rotten wood.
20: The arrow cannot make him flee: Sling-stones are turned with him into stubble.
21: Clubs are counted as stubble: He laugheth at the rushing of the javelin.
22: His underparts are like sharp potsherds: He spreadeth as it were a threshing-wain upon the mire.
23: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: He maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.
24: He maketh a path to shine after him; One would think the deep to be hoary.
25: Upon earth there is not his like, That is made without fear.
26: He beholdeth everything that is high: He is king over all the sons of pride.
